verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an identity-verification API platform could plausibly ship a sandbox with deterministic test data. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox or test environment, nor any test documents, personas, or magic values that force pass, fail, or review outcomes. Hosted flows, SDKs, APIs, and auto-decisioning are production features, not a testing harness, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox lets me exercise every outcome before going live — documented test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce pass, fail, and review results
